note: This file is NOT a capture and is NOT run through validateCapture. It is the explicit RED requirement that stands in for the absent EXECUTED native-protocol capture. The runtime mirror is NATIVE_CAPTURE_REQUIREMENT in parity-harness-native-requirement.mjs; assertParityReady() refuses any native side that is not a genuine, transcript-backed 'native-protocol' capture, so this requirement can never be mistaken for a passing native side.
whyBlocked: The producer is a compiled C++ automation test (NativeProtocolCaptureTests.cpp) that executes the native primitive handlers in a live UE editor. Building and running the editor is deferred to the integration lane (no UBT/editor in this lane), so no capture artifact exists on disk yet and cross-transport parity cannot be GREEN.

requiredProducer.name: McpAutomationBridge.Task38.NativeProtocolCapture
requiredProducer.emits: Runs the compiled McpResourceCatalog / McpResourceUri / McpSessionCapabilityProfile / McpSubscriptionStore / McpSessionConfigureStore / McpPromptCatalog / McpCompletionProvider handlers in-process and writes task38-native-capture.json { transcript[], captures[] } to $MCP_TASK38_CAPTURE_DIR.

provenance.transcriptSha256: <sha-256 of the transcript bytes each capture re-derives from>
provenance.sourceHash: <sha-256 of the plugin sources that produced the behavior>

requiredProducer.groundTruth: verifyGroundTruth requires each capture value to re-derive from a transcript entry it cites; verifyNativeCaptureProvenance re-hashes the transcript and checks freshness/source/package — a fabricated or stale capture cannot pass.

forbiddenSubstitutes: A hand-authored native oracle (captureKind 'native-model') — admissible for characterization ONLY, never for a completion claim.
A grep/source snapshot (captureKind 'source-text') — rejected outright by validateCapture with SOURCE_TEXT_CAPTURE.
A native-protocol capture missing its transcript provenance block, or one whose transcript sha / source hash / freshness no longer verifies.
unblocksWhen: The integration lane builds the plugin, runs the native capture seam against a serialized UE5.7 editor, and the emitted native-protocol captures pass ground-truth + provenance verification; assertParityReady then opens and compareCaptures runs the exact framing-neutral diff.
